dense_caption: A close-up of a hand with Indian skin tone turning a brass water faucet clockwise to the 'Off' position on a cream-colored wall. A red arrow indicates the direction of rotation. A red rectangular box highlights the hand and faucet. The back of a silver Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine with connected hoses is visible on the right.

A close-up view showing a hand with Indian skin tone unplugging a black 3-pin power cord from a white wall socket. A red rectangular box highlights the plug and socket area. To the left, the top portion of a silver Samsung WA5471 ABP top load washing machine is visible.

A close-up view of the back panel of a silver Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine, showing the hot and cold water inlet valves with hoses attached. A red rectangular box highlights the connection area.

A view of the back of a silver Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine showing the water hose connections. An orange plastic bucket with a white towel draped over the rim is placed on the floor underneath the hoses to catch water. A red rectangular box highlights the bucket and towel.

A close-up view of a hand with Indian skin tone unscrewing the hot (red) and cold (blue) water hoses from the inlet valves on the back of the Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine by turning them to the left (counter-clockwise).
A close-up view into the threaded intake valves on the back of the Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine. Small circular wire mesh filter screens are visible inside both the hot and cold water valves.
A close-up action shot showing a hand using needle-nose pliers to gently pull a wire mesh filter straight out of the water intake valve on the back of the Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine.
A view of a sink where hands are holding the removed wire mesh filters under warm running water to rinse away sand and debris.
A close-up showing a hand holding a dirty wire mesh filter while the other hand gently scrubs it with a soft toothbrush to remove stubborn debris.
A close-up view of a hand pushing the clean wire mesh filters back into their respective intake valves on the back of the Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine until they seat firmly.
A close-up view of hands screwing the water hoses back onto the intake valves of the Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine and hand-tightening them securely.

A view showing the water faucets turned back to the 'On' position, with a focus on the hose connections at the back of the Samsung WA5471 ABP washing machine where a hand is checking for any signs of leaks.
